ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values (~80%) with high-intensity (light) pixels (~20%) concentrated in the central peduncle area and scattered as small-scale focal points across the mid-lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense dark pigmentation covers the superior and lateral regions of both lobes. Light-colored, high-contrast mottling is localized around the median notch, radiating outward into the lower-middle sections. Multiple high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters are scattered across the dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; the angle is approximately 55 degrees with a significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes near the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curve along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular, high-contrast light-colored clusters ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter, heavily concentrated in the lower-central region of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detecting at least three distinct, dark linear streaks on the left lobe and two shorter marks on the right lobe, crossing the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of white, high-relief anomalies (barnacles) located on the extreme distal tips and scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated, high-intensity white encrustations localized specifically at the terminal points of the fluke lobes.
